reviews.text: 免费 有成就 没中文 《魔法技艺：法术构筑》（Magecraft: Spellbuilding） 《魔法技艺：法术构筑》是一款卡牌构建游戏，核心玩法为打造专属法术卡牌、组建独特牌组，投身地下城的回合制战斗。 尽管初始卡牌由你掌控，但随机生成的地下城布局、敌人遭遇、被动能力与卷轴，确保每一局游戏体验都截然不同。 抵御敌人的攻击 —— 摧毁敌人以保障自身安全；或是承受伤害，直接向敌人发起攻击以造成最大化伤害。 奋力闯过三个主题迥异的地下城，每个地下城都有专属的敌人待击败、可收集的能力与卷轴，以及可供选择的事件分支。 组合超过 50 种 “印记”—— 其效果涵盖造成伤害、施加减益、赋予增益、召唤盟友等 —— 为你的牌组打造定制法术卡牌。 创建角色时，可在多种外观、调色板与独特的 “背景能力” 中选择；还能解锁新的角色配色，以及拥有强大技能的新角色。 “深渊”（The Abyss）是独立游戏模式，角色与初始牌组均随机生成。与主线游戏不同，在此模式中死亡意味着需从头开启全新一局。

I love this game and hope it gets the attention it deserves. Didn't know how to get shown more than the 1st number for the wall safe riddle and just tried out every single combination till I got it right, 10/10 experience would recommend!

Attention summoner (and surprisingly necromancy) enthusiasts! This game is for you!! My god this game is so addicting, it even has insane replayability! Goodness this game has everything, secrets, boss fights, it even forces you to develop strategies and hone adaptability skills. Only thing I was a little bummed about was lore... gimmie more lore >:( (I might've not gotten far enough though)
游戏基本是爬塔和对对碰战斗作为大头，加以印卡、元素克制、卡组局内外构筑这些要素。创新没有很多，但是打起来上头。 很多个性化美术，小对话，小剧情，以及一些偶得的小惊喜，这些加起来更是锦上添花。还有两种游戏模式算作双倍快乐。 作为一款免费游戏，有这样的体量已经非常难得了；再加上不错的像素美术和很扎实的游戏玩法，让这款游戏能得到绝对的好评，相当值得尝试。

This game is so good that it feel wrong it's free. Amazing work, my only complain is... that I WANT MORE <3 And don't get me wrong, I already played for 16 hours and didn't even tested all characters so it's not like game don't have much to offer.

Wonderful deckbuilder, especially loved using poisoned and charged attacks. buffs and debuff system is nicely implemented. Bit of a nitpick but mushrooms being the only debuff with self animation is interesting. Different backgrounds really add to the fights, and amount of content whether enemys, bosses, creatable spells is really satisfying. Only, I expected to see rare or legendary cards somewhere else too instead of just while pulling new cards during a run. maybe they might've been used in other chars, which is my next point. At the beginning, the game throws too many characters at the player. Since there’s already a lot of content, having to read through large chunks of text before even getting in the game feels overwhelming and slows down the onboarding. Since I liked the game I'd love to try other chars too, but it still pushed me at the start. I also couldn’t figure out how encounters with different mini/bosses are triggered. If it’s purely random, it might take too long to experience the full variety. I loved the battle table and how it is sometimes used as a metaphorical animation like, spider opening venom - biting - closing, or trex first gaining shield and then attacking with it. also the choice at the end feels too sudden, maybe if we could choose who to beat at previous dungeons, that affecting our final desicion might feel good. Hope everything i said is clear, thanks for reading.

What an unexpectedly awesome game! Not just another deckbuilder. Sure, the map works like Slay the Spire, but there's permanent resource gathering happening (paper, ink, magical materials, gold, sigils..). These are mostly lost if you die, but those you manage to keep can be poured into a detailed spellcrafting system, and the results are cards you can use as starter decks for all future resource gathering runs. There's also a pure roguelike mode if you're not into meta progression (I'm usually not, but it's done well here). Lots of bangers on the soundtrack. Unexpectedly good writing... My only criticism is that you can't save the game easily mid-run. That being said, WHY IS THIS FREE? Play it.
What a little hidden gem. A free game with so much complexity. Already spent 10 hours in it and I can see there is so much more to unlock and so many synergies to explore. Kudos to the devs.

Only played for a bit so far, but it's gooood. The spellcraft (you get to make your own cards and what they do) is really simple but somewhat in depth, the combat is pretty fun too, also simple but gives you room to think especially with its use of status effects. Also really good aesthetic, maybe just needs more polish to make it slightly more animated, but it feels lively. My only main gripe about combat is maybe give us a way to discard spells mid-combat? Because I'm trying to get cards into my hand but I have other things clogging it. Maybe give us the chance to ditch a card, but it still consumes a charge off it as well as maybe one mana without actually getting its effects off? So it still has a cost to doing it, and picking up too many spells can still mess up your grimoire and your hand, but now it won't completely softlock you into an inevitable defeat. But yeah the TL;DR for those just looking at reviews, this game's great! Good fun if you want a roguelike with really good customization and good turn-based combat, give it a shot, see if it's for you.

The game likes to crash when I mess with fullscreen settings. I also ran in circles for over an hour on the third level because the sewer for extra HP wouldn't spawn. Otherwise its a very fun game with lots of good deckbuilding options.

Game is awesome. Amazing card crafting and deckbuilding. My first character is a goth girl who wields an all caps HEX, attack buff, and health regeneration deck named SEE YOU IN HELL. I stack for massive damage while eating hits with my duo of foxes assisting with tanking and stacks. My special is GREAT DISTAIN which scales me up for 7 turns. When my spells run out of charges I have my ultimate, GRIT. That gives me unlimited regen and attack buffs when I am stuck with struggle.

Delightful little spellcraft RPG. Lots of depth to making custom spells and custom decks, but maybe it's a little too easy to thin your deck and trivialize normal difficulty once you unlock certain tools. Also it would be appreciated to be able to save and quit mid-dungeon run.

My god... that level of quality for a Free game is a hidden gem ! This game must be share far and wide it s a great work and the music and sounds absolutly 10/10 put something for sale i ll buy ! you need to be rewarded for that work ! Seriouly! if you want to enjoy it to the fullest i sugest "hard mode right of the bat" it s hard and progress is slow but rewarding if you know your limits HAHaahHAHHA

1 hour in, I like the game already. The first battle was kind of confusing at first, but after playing your run till the end, you will pick up on the basics fast. I like the idea that you make your own spells. I was going to try the other classes, but the game consumes your time, so u gonna be careful
I have been playing for 50 hours now. This game is so good for it to just be free. I recommend others to try it out when they got time.
How is this free?! Probably one of the greatest gaming experiences I've ever had and with such great replayability.
Can't believe this game is free, lowkey wish i could pay at least a little bit for it. Insanely well made.

This is a good game, just in general. But for it to be FREE! What in the world! I have over 40 hours in this game and plan to spend many more, almost got all the achievements. I suggest doing a test run just to figure out how it works, and then jump into hard mode for better difficulty scaling.
Very fun deckbuilding roguelite, with many classes and character designs to choose from. Give it a try!
Good for several hours. Doesn't feel that you need to grind to advance in new tries.

its fun (cant believe it has a demo despite being free) bit broken what combos can work though especially in hardmode but still fun u can challenge urself by picking certain spells only for roleplay if u want to
Very fun game to play
This is one of the most fun and creative card based rougelikes I have played in a very long time!!!
